remaining_unresolved_root_causes.BROWSER_CAPTURE_NEEDED: Marriott / Hilton / Hyatt / Best Western rows whose static fetch was refused. The router sends Marriott and Hilton to the attended browser (Firecrawl is a measured wall) and excludes Hyatt and Best Western from its paid lanes; this session's browser met an Akamai challenge on marriott.com and extension read-permission refusals on marriott.com, hilton.com, hyatt.com and bestwestern.com. Next action: grant the extension read permission for those four domains and run a closure browser pass.
remaining_unresolved_root_causes.ROUTING_HOLD: no first-party route: the routing pass found no brand, bureau or map website, and Places route discovery either bound no place at the row's own street number + ZIP, or bound one whose card names no website (NO_OFFICIAL_WEB_PRESENCE_FOUND), or names a brand/OTA host.
remaining_unresolved_root_causes.ACCESS_BLOCKED: every free / authorized lane attempted (static plain client, Firecrawl where the router made the row eligible or probe-eligible) was refused or failed.
remaining_unresolved_root_causes.SOURCE_SILENT: the property's own page or site served, bound to the identity, and stated no operative pet policy on its home or policy / FAQ pages.
remaining_unresolved_root_causes.EVIDENCE_HOLD: a fee / weight / count sentence with no explicit acceptance wording, or a shared-reader disagreement; held, never published.
remaining_unresolved_root_causes.IDENTITY_MISMATCH_HOLD: the fetched page or site never confirmed this census row's address, phone or code.
